ticker: IBM Ends Visa Sponsorship for Consultants

articles.headline: Fairfax likely to exit India's IIFL Finance
articles.brief: Investment firm Fairfax is reportedly preparing to exit its stake in India's IIFL Finance, according to people familiar with the matter. The potential divestment marks a significant shift for the financial services company.

articles.headline: India orders website takedowns on fake court orders
articles.brief: An exclusive investigation reveals that Indian authorities ordered website takedowns following the circulation of fake court orders, prompting an active police probe into the sophisticated forgery operation.

articles.headline: Eleven Pakistani police personnel feared killed in attack
articles.brief: A rescue group reports that at least eleven Pakistani police personnel are feared killed following a severe militant attack in the region. Emergency response teams have launched rescue operations in the affected area.

articles.headline: Moody's lifts India economic growth forecast to 7%
articles.brief: Moody's Ratings has upgraded India's growth outlook, noting that the domestic economy is exceptionally well-positioned to sustain near 7% GDP growth driven by robust fundamentals and steady investment.

articles.headline: Meta infrastructure head Janardhan to depart in 2027
articles.brief: Meta's long-serving infrastructure chief, Janardhan, has announced plans to step down from his leadership role in early 2027. The tech giant will begin transitioning his responsibilities over the coming months.

articles.headline: China Singles Day festival tests new AI selling power
articles.brief: China's massive Singles Day shopping festival has commenced, serving as a major commercial proving ground for advanced artificial intelligence selling power and automated consumer engagement tools across major e-commerce platforms.

articles.headline: Trump defends Iran war during Veterans Day address
articles.brief: In a Veterans Day address, former US President Donald Trump defended the military conflict with Iran, stating that the long-standing hostility was initiated by Tehran rather than Washington.

articles.headline: AAP questions CAQM over alleged Delhi AQI manipulation
articles.brief: The Aam Aadmi Party met with the Commission for Air Quality Management, raising serious concerns regarding alleged manipulation of air quality index readings at monitoring stations across the capital.

articles.headline: India slashes visa categories and application form fields
articles.brief: The Ministry of Home Affairs has streamlined India's visa process by reducing categories from 13 to 9 and cutting application form columns by up to 70 percent to enhance ease of travel.

articles.headline: Net direct tax collections rise 11.8% in FY27
articles.brief: India's net direct tax collections grew by 11.76% to reach ₹14.42 trillion, led by strong corporate tax receipts despite higher refunds moderating overall net figures.

articles.headline: Amul announces 5.5% milk price hike from November 12
articles.brief: Amul has announced a price hike of ₹2 to ₹4 per litre across major markets effective November 12, citing rising production, cattle feed, and processing expenditures.

articles.headline: Record FPI buying pushes Sensex near nine-month high
articles.brief: Foreign portfolio investors poured over ₹73,200 crore into Indian equities in November, driving benchmark indices like the Sensex to near nine-month highs amid positive corporate earnings.

articles.headline: IBM tells visa holders to relocate or leave by year-end
articles.brief: IBM is ending US visa and green card sponsorships for most roles within its massive consulting division, giving affected employees the choice to relocate abroad or depart by the end of the year.
